messages:
morgan-arch: Quick RFC follow-up 1: proposing a 'micro-cohort rolling' pattern: tiny tenant cohorts (~0.35%) with bounded probabilistic overlap to help warm caches faster while keeping per-tenant signal clarity.

sasha-sre: Interesting. How do we bound overlap so it doesn't become a hidden percent ramp?

morgan-arch: Plan: overlap_pct=10% of previous cohort only. Deterministic selector so membership is reproducible: (hash(tenant_id) XOR epoch) % P < K.

tomi-platform: We need an exclusion list for shared infra tenants and a weight attr to avoid heavy tenants skewing metrics.

ev an-ml: evan-ml: (typo) I'll build a micro-eval harness (N=40 prompts) to run in gating windows and compute a quick delta. Hook it before promoting next cohort.

sasha-sre: Rollback semantics? Immediate reroute for new requests and short quiesce (15s) for in-flight seems safe. Also emit incident event and tag telemetry.

morgan-arch: Agreed. Also add min_requests_per_window and adaptive windowing: extend window until min_requests or max 10min then mark insufficient.

tomi-platform: Console needs per-cohort lanes + overlap view, pause/step/force-promote buttons (admin only). Also persist cohort membership for postmortem.

sasha-sre: Telemetry gating: Bayesian fusion across latency/errors/eval-delta so single noisy metric can't auto-rollback. Tune priors per model.

evan-ml: Make baseline snapshot at canary start to compare micro-eval outputs. Keep eval fast (<2s per request).

morgan-arch: Ownership: tomi->route-change/console, sasha->telemetry+rollback automation, evan->micro-eval. I'll draft RFC with selection math and gate formulas. Target: RFC in 10 days.

deploy-bot: [note] created pipeline micro_cohort_roll v0.1 by morgan-arch. Hooks: staging-eval, telemetry-gates, rollback-hook, emergency-stop.

morgan-arch: Thanks all. If no objections I'll proceed. :thumbsup:
